extracted.name: Best Steak Marinade in Existence
extracted.description: This steak marinade is the best and simple to make with soy sauce, olive oil, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, garlic, and a few dried herbs.
instruction_lines: Place olive oil, soy sauce, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, basil, garlic powder, parsley, white pepper, minced garlic, and hot pepper sauce in a blender; blend on high speed until thoroughly combined, about 30 seconds.
Use to marinate steak before cooking, or store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 5 days.
